facts.business: Cranes Software International Limited is engaged in software development and related services through its subsidiaries including Systat Software and other entities.

auditor.name: Chaturvedi Sohan & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Going concern uncertainty with negative net-worth and pending legal cases; 2) Legal proceedings by Bank of India under NI Act; 3) Investments valued at cost instead of fair value per accounting policy; 4) Non-provision of Expected Credit Loss on non-performing assets (Investments Rs 3,215.88 lakhs, Loans Rs 902.16 lakhs, Trade receivables Rs 1,399.24 lakhs); 5) Non-accounting of statutory dues and defaults; 6) Inadequate securities for bank borrowings; 7) Unpaid loan from UPS Capital Business Credit since April 2014 with unprovided interest of Rs 56.89 lakhs for year; 8) Discontinued foreign exchange restatement on UPS Capital liability per Ind AS-21.

key_risks: Negative net-worth and going concern uncertainty
Pending legal cases including Bank of India proceedings under NI Act
Non-provision of Expected Credit Loss on significant receivables and investments
Inadequate security coverage for bank borrowings
Long-overdue foreign currency loan from UPS Capital Business Credit since 2014
Non-compliance with Ind AS for fair valuation of investments and foreign exchange restatement
